title: Section 16 CPC — Where subject-matter is situate

content.overview: Section 16 CPC pins specified immovable-property suits to the court within whose local limits the property is situate, subject to pecuniary and other statutory limits.
content.study: If the suit is for land, partition of land, mortgage of land, or a right in immovable property, start with Section 16. The proviso covers relief obtainable through the defendant's personal obedience. Sections 17 to 19 deal with property in more than one jurisdiction and wrongs to person or movables. Section 20 is the residual defendant/cause-of-action rule.
